notes.notes:

[h1]New Content[/h1]

notes.title: Supercharge Pack
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32328751/38d0d890b71639b377714e36fd5e8e40a2f6c37d.png[/img]

Greetings everyone,

The first DLC content for V-Rally 4 is available to download on Steam! Read the Patch Notes below for more details on its content.


[h1]New Content[/h1]

5 new unique liveries have been added to the game for the following cars:
[list]
[*]Porsche 911 RGT 997 (Rallye)
[*]Volkswagen Polo RX (Rallycross)
[*]Volkswagen Polo R RWC (Rallye)
[*]Tatum Class 10 (Buggy)
[*]Ford Mustang Fastback (Extreme-Khana)
[/list]

[h1]IU Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Ability to change the livery through a new button (e.g: you can now play in Quick Game with a livery created in the V-Rally mode).
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes version 1.03
notes.notes:
[img]https://scontent-frx5-1.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t1.0-0/q86/p526x395/47487812_2236769853272742_4872149735953137664_o.jpg?_nc_cat=109&_nc_ht=scontent-frx5-1.xx&oh=a23054d94d47140c34b2019ecd7ce252&oe=5CA261A9[/img]


Version (1.03) for V-Rally 4 is available to download on Steam! Read the Patch Notes below for more details on its content.

[h1]Feature & Compatibility Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added a new FFB (force feedback) parameter (disabled by default) for road feelings.
[*]Mapped two new actions to look at each side of the car.
[*]Identical controllers added for different uses.
[*]Fixed default bindings for some Fanatec wheels: CSL Elite McLaren GT3, ClubSport Steering Wheel Porsche 918 RSR, ClubSport Steering Wheel BMW GT2, ClubSport Steering Wheel Formula Carbon, ClubSport steering wheel Formula Black.
[*]Fixed filtering setting for Fanatec CSL Pedals Elite LC.
[/list]

[h1]Know Issues Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added the possibility to skip introduction movies with the gamepad.
[*]Fixed device detection for split screen races. 
[*]Crash fix when opening the Display options menu on some 4K configurations.
[/list]

[h1]Translation[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed Korean language support.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes version 1.02
notes.notes:
[img]https://scontent-cdg2-1.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t1.0-0/p526x395/43045095_2198750120408049_6964855478434136064_o.jpg?_nc_cat=106&oh=d0f4cf97c0ca6a8c6a1b8bd335edfdff&oe=5C621E74[/img]

A new version (1.02) for V-Rally 4 is now available to download on Steam! Read the Patch Notes below for more details on its content.

[h1]Feature & Compatibility Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]The game is now compatible with the D-Box simulator.
[*]The Photo Mode is now accessible through the Pause menu.
[*]Only keyboard inputs allowed when changing keyboard bindings.
[*]The FFB configuration files can now be modified in the documents folder.
[/list]

[h1]Know Issues Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Back to main menu after disconnecting steering wheel or pad.
[*]Loading crash in some cases.
[*]Introduction crash fix.
[/list]

notes.title: V-Rally 4 is now available on Steam!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32328751/7262224931ab06fdb267ada5413b20f4881c56e7.jpg[/img]The legend has returned! V-Rally 4 is now available Steam, Xbox One and PlayStation 4. It will be released for Nintendo Switch during Winter 2018.


Main features:
[list]
    [*][b]V-Rally Mode[/b]: V-Rally's Career mode represents the heart of the racing experience.
    [*][b]Quick race[/b]: quickly access all the game's content (vehicles and environments), for all categories. There's nothing better for training, testing vehicles, and getting used to their handling.
    [*][b]Multiplayer[/b]: online with up to 8 players, or offline split-screen.
    [*][b]22 environments and Stage Generator[/b]: numerous pre-generated tracks and the ability to drive created special stages in Rally mode.
    [*][b]Vehicle customisation[/b]: in Career mode, a livery editor allows you to completely customise your vehicle and give it the colours you want! 
    [*][b]More than 50 cars[/b]: Collect legendary historic (Lancia Delta S4, Porsche Carrera SC Safari, Mustang Fastback…) and modern (Ford Focus RS RX, MINI John Cooper Works, Volkswagen Polo R WRC…) cars
[/list]

notes.title: V-Rally 4 review - a 90s throwback that's too clumsy for its own good
notes.notes:
How long has it been since the last unabashed, bluntly straightforward and no frills arcade racer? So much time has passed it may as well have been 2002's V-Rally 3, the last instalment of a series that's getting an unlikely revival in this, the latest outing from Parisian racing specialists Kylotonn. V-Rally 4 is a nostalgia trip of a game - not least for some of its development team who worked on the original games - and one that harks back to a bygone, if not necessarily better, era.

And it's all a bit of a shock at first. V-Rally 4's cars are nervy little things, hopping about in your hands like Mexican jumping beans as they throw around their meagre weight. That skittishness, it turns out - and if you can remember as far back as the original V-Rally games I'm sure you don't need reminding - was always part of the original DNA, and it's preserved here, for better and for worse. There's a period of readjustment you'll have to endure, through which V-Rally 4 can feel every bit as challenging as more hardcore simulations such as Dirt Rally.

See through that - and it is worth it, just - and you've got a knowingly lightweight handling model that lets you dance these things around (and counterintuitive it might be if you're a veteran of the genre, but V-Rally 4 does seem to function a whole lot better when you're playing via one of the third-person chase cams, where it's all a bit more explicit that you're not supposed to take this thing too seriously). There's a generous enough window to operate in, when you find it, meaning that you shouldn't bemoan the lack of a rewind feature too heavily even on the longer stages.
